name: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
 1. The applicant must be aged between 18 to 50 years.
 1. The applicant must be a beneficiary of the &amp;quot;Ganga Swarup Economic Assistance Scheme&amp;quot;.

name: Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.
 1. The applicant must have graduated or obtained an equivalent degree (including Alim or Shastri) after April 25, 2018, from a government-recognized or affiliated institution within Bihar.
 1. The scheme applies to graduates from general, technical, or professional courses.
 1. The applicant must have an account in any nationalized bank, recognized private bank or India Postal Payment Bank located in Bihar.

name: Leprosy Pension Scheme
eligibility_text:
1. It is necessary to be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.
1. Disabled due to leprosy (with any percentage of disability).
1. Persons with disabilities due to leprosy may belong to any age group.
1. Must be below the poverty and should be under Rs. 56,460/- per annum for urban and Rs. 46,080/- per annum for rural areas. 
1. Are not taking advantage of other pension schemes.

name: Indira Gandhi National Special Ability Pension
eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 2. The person must be between 18 to 79 years old. 3. The applicant should have 80% or more special ability. 4. The person should belong to a below-poverty-line household. 5. The applicant should have a valid bank account.

name: Tricycles - Tamil Nadu
eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be affected by both lower limbs and upper limbs should be normal. 
1. The applicant should be a resident of the district/area of Tamil Nadu. 
1. The applicant's age should be 12 years or above.

name: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. Only children aged 0 to 18 years of specially-abled parents are eligible for assistance.
1. The child must be between 2 to 5 years of age and enrolled in an Anganwadi or school.
1. Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution.
1. The family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.

name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Primitive Tribes, or be a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a woman-headed household, a person with disabilities, or a beneficiary of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY). 1. The applicant should be a small or marginal farmer. 1. The applicant should possess a MGNREGA job card. 1. The applicant's livelihood should primarily depend on agriculture.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana
eligibility_text: 1. This benefit is provided as a subsidy for the construction of homestays across the state of Uttarakhand, excluding areas under Municipal Corporations and Municipalities. 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The building owner, who resides in the building with their family, may construct a minimum of one and a maximum of six guest rooms. 1. Upon construction of a new homestay or renovation of an existing one, the property must be registered with the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin, Uttarakhand
eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The selection of eligible beneficiaries for housing is done based on the “Social, Economic and Caste Census 2011 (SECC-2011)” and the Awaas Plus Permanent Waiting List.

name: Rotavator/Thresher Machine Equipment Assistance Scheme
eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a resident of tribal or forest areas of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a farmer dependent on agriculture as the main source of livelihood. 1. The applicant should intend to use the machinery for self-employment and agricultural purposes.
